protocol.preserved: all other state fields including identities, primary facts, projections, journal/results, actual observations; every immutable version and current mirror byte hash
protocol.boundary: one writer per isolated directory, real os._exit, existing JSON/immutable-version filesystem; not power loss, machine loss, distributed consensus or arbitrary plugin transactions

supplemental_exception_probe.reason: Separate post-commit acknowledgement exception regression; not one of the ten os._exit cuts

protocol.scope: one common trusted checkpoint per action family, copied byte-for-byte to control and fault worlds; stable command identities for new actions

requirement_snapshot.goal: 更新 model，保持公式可重算并完成增长率×利润率敏感性分析；本项仅提交模型。
visible_requirements: 资料均为合成材料。按指定来源、期间、单位和版本工作；请先阅读 guide。
从 financials 获取本期收入和经营利润率，从历史邮件或负责人澄清获取 scope。
更新 model 的 Inputs 并保留可重算公式；Sensitivity!B2:C3 为股价结果公式。
Sensitivity!B1:C1 为 growth_grid，A2:A3 为 margin_delta_grid；所有结果引用模型输入。
写入时用 dependencies 记录 financials 和适用的 basis 版本；有可用确认可直接采用，不必重复请求。

source_tree_inspection.algorithm: SHA256 over sorted src/**/*.py relative pathname bytes followed by file bytes; same algorithm as code_identity

archive_provenance.method: Read-only JSON and byte-hash inspection; no World initialization, recovery, action execution, or experiment rerun.
archive_provenance.comparison_scope: Original 60 checks compare normalized full persisted state (only wall_seconds and state_digests removed), all registered immutable version bytes, all current mirror bytes, command result and second retry effects. Supplementary post-commit exception is separate: 4 checks, not an eleventh os._exit cut.
archive_provenance.preserved_details: Original protocol, all 60 checks, all 10 cut markers, all errors/process outputs, reported committed_revision_before_resume, all four control inventories/results, and all four supplementary exception checks are retained in full; no artifact maps omitted.
archive_provenance.pre_resume_snapshot_limit: committed_revision_before_resume was recorded during each original trial; the full pre-resume state snapshot is not separately persisted and is not claimed to have been revalidated from the final recovered state.
